channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 16 new entries
item.description: VirTues, a marker-aware foundation model for multiplex spatial proteomics, lands in Nature and is easily the week's biggest addition. Foundation models keep multiplying, with TissueFormer pretrained on 17M histology-expression pairs. Beyond transcriptomics, 10X ExMSI's tenfold sample-expansion MALDI-MSI pushes lipid imaging down to ~500 nm resolution.
